name: Wa Chi Choi
title: Psychologist
description: Since 2010, in my capacity as Clinical Psychologist and Social Worker, I provide support to clients and the community on issues related to childhood trauma, attachment problems, behavioral addiction, and crisis intervention. I employ an integrated strategy that combines research findings with practical application in order to deliver effective assessment and treatment. I utilize various therapeutic approaches, including EFT, ACT, EMDR, and CBT, to help my clients achieve mental wellness.
